name: Vraska, the Cutting Glare
description: A gorgon and former assassin who believes Jace is dead, keeps the young Loot out of harm's way, and resolves to stop Jace when she hears he may have survived.

timeline.summary: Hearing rumors that Jace survived, Vraska resolves that she must be the one to stop him.
timeline.quote: Vraska resolves that she must be the one to stop him.

relations.note: Jace is the love of her life.
relations.quote: Believing that Jace, the love of her life, is dead

relations.note: She keeps Loot as her ward.
relations.quote: She keeps the young Loot, her strange ward, out of harm's way
